purpose: Rebind the unchanged pre-fold Binance filter snapshots and weekly CORE-20 derivation to the protected zero-gap PIT-v8 authority before any strategy outcome is read.
source_policy: Each payload is the raw Binance USD-M GET /fapi/v1/exchangeInfo response preserved by the Internet Archive. The Binance response serverTime and archive capture timestamp must both be strictly earlier than the fold start.
fold_policy: For each fold, use the newest listed snapshot whose captured_at and server_time are strictly earlier than fold start, freeze it for the whole fold, and derive filter-eligible CORE-20 cells from the PIT-v8 weekly ranking without changing ranking order.
filter_policy: Use PRICE_FILTER.tickSize, MARKET_LOT_SIZE.stepSize/minQty/maxQty and MIN_NOTIONAL.notional exactly as the engine does. Duplicate, missing, non-finite, zero or negative required values are INCOMPLETE.
identity_effect: This is an authority-only rebind. Snapshot bytes, fold bindings and derived weekly membership digests are identical to v2; only the protected PIT authority identity changes from v4 to v8.
known_limitation: Rules are last-observed at fold start, not a claim that Binance never changed them during the fold. PAPER/testnet admission must independently pass current exchangeInfo parity.
forbidden: changing any snapshot byte, capture time, server time, fold binding or weekly membership digest from v2
backfilling a symbol from a snapshot captured after its fold starts
dropping a symbol after reading its candidate outcome
invented or inferred tick, quantity or notional rules
